chunks: And do not lose hope for the worst of this community from the mercy of Allah, because of His, the Exalted, saying: 'Verily, he despairs not of Allah's mercy but the disbelieving people.'

key_terms.رَوْحِ اللَّهِ: The mercy or spirit of Allah

ai.seo_question: Why should Muslims not lose hope for sinners?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) uses this verse to counter the pessimism of those who judge the community's spiritual state by its worst elements, emphasizing that divine mercy remains accessible until the final breath. This perspective is foundational in Shia theology for maintaining hope (tawakkul) in individual redemption and collective salvation, distinguishing true faith from the despair characteristic of the disbelievers (al-kafirun).
